reviews.comment: Dr Peak is a leading contributing factor to me having a mental breakdown because I had him for 2 classes in 1 semester. It's one thing to be challenging, but he's just a very condescending man with no empathy for students. He will be the bane of your BMEN experience unfortunately but he's usually the only teacher so you got to deal with it.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader

reviews.comment: BMEN 343 lab was so rough because Dr. Peak thinks all the post-labs should take a max of 2 hours per week when really it takes upwards of 8 (for one credit hour). The rubric is very subjective to the TAs, so it's really a hit or miss. 343 lab was truly the bane of my existence because of this man.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader

reviews.comment: Dr. Peak is undoubtedly a challenging professor, but what do you expect in an engineering major? 90% of BMEN classes at TAMU require zero intuition and are insanely easy to get an A. He has a clear goal of challenging students and those who complain are too used to being handheld. His classes will prepare you well for the real world.
Humble yourself, Dr. Peak.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Charles Peak is the bane of my undergrad career. He gives unclear instructions while assuming you know how to do everything. He has unrealistically high standards and makes a 1-hour credit lab extremely time-consuming. His lab manual is badly written, and the pre and post-lab questions are frustrating since they require a lot of internet research.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader

reviews.comment: I have never had a professor like this one before. Incredibly unclear instructions, talks down to you as if you are 5 years old in such a demeaning manor it ruins an already intolerable lecture or lab.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: He will expect you to know and understand things without telling you. In addition, he won't grade assignments until the next one is done, so you cannot apply what you did wrong. Don't think about asking him questions, he will give you sas back.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Beware of pop quizzes--So many papers

reviews.comment: Dr. Peak is notoriously disliked by undergrads in the department. He is rude, snarky, and harsh for no reason. He creates hostile learning environments.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Basically taught myself everything. In class lectures were anything but helpful since he would give us a problem and the answer, give us a very vague way to work it out and then would say "I've done everything I can to help you". He was rude, obnoxious, and entitled. The weekly quizzes ruined my grade. Exam averages were 60's at best.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Peak's flipped classroom is annoying and can be quite damaging to your mental health. He tends to do the minimum work and anticipates you to work on your own a lot. He is the opposite of caring. His voice is very irritating to listen to as well.
Quit whining about taking a hard class. This class is not difficult if you actually put in the effort and go to office hours if you are confused. Dr. Peak is always willing to help.
reviews.ratingTags: EXTRA CREDIT--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: He is so awful.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: This is probably the hardest class I have taken so far. I agree the material can be tough to understand but if the professor is understanding and willing to help, then all the students can pass the class. There was a gap between teaching and lecture in that the professor expects more from you than you are already and assigns lecture videos.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Peak is a man of contradictions. He will insult you, say he has given you everything to be successful, COMPLAIN about the grade distribution, yet make the class more difficult by taking away reference sheets; make mistakes but forget to follow up and correct them; gives you examples that make you walk away feeling even more confused after class
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Group projects

reviews.comment: The amount of work he gives simply dissuades students from wanting to try in the class. He goes over material too fast and skips steps as if this isn't most of BMEN's first circuits class. The mixture of pre-lecture videos, in-class attendance, homework, and in-person night quizzes is terrible. The structure of the class is not good for learning.

He gives out many resources for students to use for studying but he expects too much out of students. The lectures seem basic enough, but when it comes to exams and quizzes, they're much harder and not always on what he focuses on in lecture. He cares about his students but mostly when it's convenient for him. You have to study HARD to do well.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Peak is a great guy who cares about his students, but I think his tests are absolutely ridiculous. I do think that he is still learning and adapting to the curriculum/how to teach it, because the material is innately difficult, but sometimes he doesn't know how to explain things and brushes you off when you say you don't understand. Go to OH!!
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Dr. Peak cares about his students. However, he expects way too much out you. The basics are covered in class and it is expected that you can magically do the hardest problems he can think of. The online homework he assigns is not related to anything he teaches as far as I can tell and is more of a burden than helpful. Study HARD for his tests.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Dr. Peak is fine, but that is about it. He gives out lots of work; weekly homework, group quizzes, and tough in-class quizzes bi-weekly. He treats his class like you don't have 4 other courses that are just as difficult as his. His tests and quizzes go way beyond what we cover in class so prepare with the MOST difficult problems you can find.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Test heavy

reviews.comment: good

reviews.comment: Im not sure why others dislike Dr. Peak but in my experience hes a pretty good professor and the class is really easy. I found him to grade fairly and one time he even let me turn in an assignment late for less possible points but thats still rare in a prof.
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Group projects--Caring

reviews.comment: This class is useless, goes over information that your high school counselor probably gave you in a random presentation during assembly. Peak makes this course exponentially worse with his power trips.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Peak was new professor when I took electronics. he was straight forward with us when he said it was his first time. Great to talk to in office hours. Caring prof but you need to put in the time for this class. Homework is not graded but good for test. The class is hard and he was new so I think he did the best he could when he isnt electonics prof
reviews.ratingTags: BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: This was an easy A class, but he made it dreadful. Class was mandatory and we weren't allowed to be on our laptops while he lectured. Even though lectures were on practically useless topics. You have other profs from the department come and introduce you to different tracks, but that is about as interesting as it gets.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Dr. Peaks course is really just an attendance class with a few assignments that arent too terrible. He grades easy and fair and the class is designed to help you grasp the major and it achieves that goal. I wish it was more than one credit.
